adaptive_policy.rule: Select runtime-exact, epoch-cap-feasible mixtures from a deterministic candidate pool after excluding every Wave-1 coordinate. Exploitation spans the frozen Hellinger-squared penalty grid using one representative ridge setting per eligible coordinate model; local refinement uses count transfers around those optima and the validated-frontier transfer anchor; disagreement maximizes prediction spread across eligible coordinate models, or across the frozen spatial-fold ensemble if only one coordinate model is eligible. Ties are broken by runtime-count tuple.

acquisition.outcome_blind_policy: Before opening Wave-1 endpoints, reserve full-rank square-root-coordinate maximin coverage outside the Wave-1 coordinates. These rows do not depend on outcomes or model predictions.

confirmation.rule: Confirm the three distinct predicted mixtures with the best spatial-crossfit-supported selection scores, paired against exact tied continuations under common random numbers. A canonical frontier claim additionally requires same-hardware confirmation.

corrective_amendment.reason: A read-only CC review found an unpaired Wave-2 data seed, a row-budget overflow for three eligible ridge settings, and a mismatch between coordinate model classes and ridge hyperparameter settings. The amendment restores the Wave-1 common-random-number seed, chooses one representative ridge setting per coordinate model, and uses the fold ensemble only when one coordinate model survives. No observed endpoint value or ordering was used.

eligibility.baseline_rule: Use data seed 970000 for every Wave-2 fit row so effects remain paired to the existing Wave-1 common-random-number tied control.

candidate_models: direct tangent-space ridge plus nonnegative Hellinger-squared damage

model_selection.primary_validation: nested spatially blocked cross-validation RMSE on scalar Uncheatable BPB
secondary_diagnostics: calibration on five-repeat tied and validated-frontier noise groups
model_selection.selection_rule: Choose the simplest candidate within one standard error of the best spatially blocked RMSE, provided it does not reverse the sign of gain on more than one outer fold. Open the eight Wave-1 sealed referees only after this choice.
